title: Wireless firmware versions MR 31.1.1 changelog

announcements.post_subject: A new beta wireless firmware is now available on Tue, 21 May 2024

Important note: Wi-Fi 5 Wave 2 MRs support - This version and subsequent MR 31.x.x are only supported on 802.11ax (Wi-Fi 6) and newer MR models. 802.11ac Wave 2 and older products will not upgrade if they are in networks configured for MR 31.x.x versions, and thus, the new features will not be available. The bug fixes listed below will also not apply to Wi-Fi wave 2 and older MRs. (https://documentation.meraki.com/MR/Other_Topics/Cisco_Meraki_MR_Firmware_Restrictions_Overview_and_FAQ)
New feature: Support to set an IP address for NAS-ID(https://documentation.meraki.com/MR/Access_Control/MR_Meraki_RADIUS_2.0)
Adding 6 GHz Radio support for 20 Countries
Bug fixes: In high-capacity wireless networks, APs may experience instability when the “Client Balancing” feature is enabled (Wi-Fi 5 Wave 2, Wi-Fi 6 and Wi-Fi 6E APs)
Known issues: Sporadic packet loss & instability on Layer 3 roaming & Teleworker VPN SSID's (Wi-Fi 5 Wave 2 and Wi-Fi 6 APs)
Clients may experience intermittent re-auth issues on MR45/55 APs
AFC not available on CW9163E APs

html:
Wireless firmware versions MR 31.1.1 changelog

Important note

  • WEP deprecation (https://documentation.meraki.com/MR/Encryption_and_Authentication/WEP_Deprecation_on_MRs)
  • Wi-Fi 5 Wave 2 MRs support - This version and subsequent MR 31.x.x are only supported on 802.11ax (Wi-Fi 6) and newer MR models. 802.11ac Wave 2 and older products will not upgrade if they are in networks configured for MR 31.x.x versions, and thus, the new features will not be available. The bug fixes listed below will also not apply to Wi-Fi wave 2 and older MRs. (https://documentation.meraki.com/MR/Other_Topics/Cisco_Meraki_MR_Firmware_Restrictions_Overview_and_FAQ)

New feature

  • Support RADSec with Tunneled SSIDs(https://documentation.meraki.com/MR/Encryption_and_Authentication/MR_RADSec)
  • Support RADSec keep alives (https://documentation.meraki.com/MR/Encryption_and_Authentication/MR_RADSec)
  • Support CoA with RADSec (https://documentation.meraki.com/MR/Encryption_and_Authentication/MR_RADSec)
  • Support to set an IP address for NAS-ID(https://documentation.meraki.com/MR/Access_Control/MR_Meraki_RADIUS_2.0)
  • WPA3 Transition mode for 802.1X (https://documentation.meraki.com/MR/Wi-Fi_Basics_and_Best_Practices/WPA3_Encryption_and_Configuration_Guide)
  • AP Auto Locate (https://documentation.meraki.com/MR/AP_Auto_Locate)
  • Assa Abloy (https://documentation.meraki.com/MR/Assa_Abloy%E2%80%99s_Zigbee_Integration_with_MRs)
  • SGT Enhancements (https://documentation.meraki.com/General_Administration/Cross-Platform_Content/Adaptive_Policy_MR_Configuration_Guide)
  • Rogue Detection Outside Regulatory Domain (https://documentation.meraki.com/MR/Monitoring_and_Reporting/Air_Marshal)
  • Adding 6 GHz Radio support for 20 Countries

Bug fixes

  • General stability and performance improvements
  • Roaming-related issues with 802.11r configured SSID
  • In high-capacity wireless networks, APs may experience instability when the “Client Balancing” feature is enabled (Wi-Fi 5 Wave 2, Wi-Fi 6 and Wi-Fi 6E APs)

Known issues

  • Sporadic packet loss & instability on Layer 3 roaming & Teleworker VPN SSID's (Wi-Fi 5 Wave 2 and Wi-Fi 6 APs)
  • Clients may experience intermittent re-auth issues on MR45/55 APs
  • AFC not available on CW9163E APs
